reason: Full independent review of the 1,284-line pinned Pix Android Component raw with matching trusted SHA. The five quotes, Sessions/Advanced version and field distinctions, InstantPaymentComponent, QR/Pending finality, past example expiries, refund/test/live qualifications, concept suggestion, and Q1/Q2 routes are otherwise sound. One retained claim materially misdirects an Android implementer: the Advanced takeaway says paymentMethod comes from the Component's `state.data.paymentMethod` on submit, adopting raw line 746's web-style wording as an Android API mapping. The captured Android Advanced base guide instead serializes state.data as paymentComponentJson in ComponentCallback.onSubmit (raw advanced-flow lines 13098–13114, 13242–13244) and describes /payments paymentMethod as paymentComponentData.paymentMethod (line 13253). The source entry should qualify this mismatch rather than prescribe the web-style property path for Android.
required_changes: In the Advanced /payments takeaway, retain that paymentMethod and amount are marked required, but remove the unqualified claim that the Android Component supplies `state.data.paymentMethod`. State that the Pix add-on table uses this wording while the Android Advanced base guide documents serialized ComponentCallback state.data/paymentComponentData.paymentMethod; direct readers to verify the Android handoff. A concise warning is appropriate. Keep the other field, expiry, and outcome scopes intact.
